#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Repeat the saved one-iteration suite; credentials come only from environment."""
import json,time,sys
from pathlib import Path
from api import call
root=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
body=json.loads((root/'launch.json').read_text())
# Supply a fresh key for a deliberately new run, or reuse one to retry safely.
if len(sys.argv)>1: body['idempotencyKey']=sys.argv[1]
r=call('POST','/projects/project_fixture/eval-runs',body,'launch-latest')
if r['http_status']!=202: sys.exit(2)
data=r['body']; runid=data.get('runId') or data.get('id')
if not runid: raise RuntimeError('Launch response has no run ID')
path='/projects/project_fixture/eval-runs/'+runid
for i in range(30):
 r=call('GET',path,name='status-latest')
 if r['http_status']!=200: sys.exit(3)
 if r['body'].get('status') in ['completed','failed','cancelled','timed_out']: break
 time.sleep(2)
else: sys.exit(4)
call('GET',path+'/iterations',name='iterations-latest')
call('GET',path+'/decision-summary',name='decision-latest')
sys.exit(0 if r['body'].get('status')=='completed' and r['body'].get('result') in ['passed','pass'] else 5)
PY
